upload.title: Conjunctiva Capture
upload.subtitle: A clear lower-eyelid image is the foundation of a reliable screening. Use natural light, hold steady, and pull the lid down gently.
upload.tip1: Use natural, even lighting - avoid direct flash.
upload.tip2: Rest your phone on a surface to reduce motion blur.
upload.tip3: Pull the lower eyelid down gently to expose the inner conjunctiva.
upload.tip4: Hold the phone 15-20 cm from the eye for best focus.

quality.title: Quality Assessment
quality.passed: Image passed all validation criteria - ready for analysis.
quality.failed: Critical issues detected. Retake recommended for accuracy and stronger reliability.
quality.allQualityOptimal: All quality metrics within optimal range.

intake.title: Symptoms First
intake.subtitle: Start with only the symptom context that actually matters for triage. Extra profile details are optional and stay out of the way.
intake.optionalProfileNote: Age, sex, and diet are optional. The screening still works without them.
intake.workflowImpactDetail: Symptoms are the main triage input here. Optional profile context is only used if you choose to add it.
intake.symptomChecklistDetail: Select only what is actually present. This is the main clinical context the triage layer should weigh after the image model runs.

symptoms.title: Symptom Profile
symptoms.subtitle: Tap each symptom to set severity. Fuses with image biomarkers for better triage accuracy.
